definitions.explanation: The area beneath the surface of the earth.
The floor or floors of a building below street level.

examples.japanese: {地下|ちか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧ (subway, underground railway)
- ⟦{地下街|ちかがい}→地下街：09390_chikagai⟧ (underground shopping area)
- ⟦{地下室|ちかしつ}→地下室：12047_chikashitsu⟧ (basement room)
- ⟦{地下水|ちかすい}→地下水：09600_chikasui⟧ (groundwater)
- ⟦{地下道|ちかどう}→地下道：06495_chikadou⟧ (underground passage)

FLOOR NOTATION:
- {地下|ちか}1⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧ (B1F - first basement floor)
- {地下|ちか}2⟦{階|かい}→階：01034_kai⟧ (B2F - second basement floor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {地下|ちか} (underground) ↔ ⟦{地上|ちじょう}→地上：12108_chijou⟧ (above ground)

CULTURAL NOTE: Japanese cities have extensive ⟦{地下街|ちかがい}→地下街：09390_chikagai⟧ (underground shopping malls) and ⟦{地下鉄|ちかてつ}→地下鉄：01020_chikatetsu⟧ systems, especially in major cities like Tokyo and Osaka.
